I replied in the #coastal-team thread. Bettina did say 12%, but she corrected it five minutes later on 2025-11-17: "please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%." She had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. The 10% was posted in the same channel, so repeating it there is allowed.

I couldn't find a contract or order form in the files I can read, so the 10% is not confirmed against a signed rate. The message is also almost a year old. I told Kwame to check the figure with June or Sofia before it goes in the brief, since the cheat sheet suggests Saltmarsh is Sofia's account.
